text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from a day out with
Sakura
Bakushin O, she tells me all
about one of her
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was the girl who was leaving the
academy. The one who said how she
wanted to give her best for
her final
race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We've done everything we could!
She'll
definitely come in first place!
choice_data_list: Her final race is tomorrow, huh.
Her final race is tomorrow, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the race, all of Sakura
Bakushin O's
classmates rush to watch
the scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You got this! Show us your best
Bakushin!
choice_data_list: It's finally time for the real deal.
It's finally time for the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN! Right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, as the race begins, Sakura
Bakushin O
and the other spectators let
out an immense
cheer.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: That's it, that's it! You're in the zone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's it! There! Show them the fruits of
your
training!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: (Baku, everyone... Thank you so much)

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: (Watch! This is my...)

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: FULL POWER BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is finally over and the results
are in...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Fifth! Fifth! She managed to place!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, she's waving! She looks so happy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Classmate D
text_block_list.text: Baku?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is noticeably shaken
after seeing the results, so I grab her
hand and take her
somewhere we can
talk without any onlookers.
choice_data_list: Sorry, let me go have a private wo...
Sorry, let me go have a private wo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sniff... My power wasn't enough!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Despite being the class representative...
Despite
saying I would help her! She still
couldn't take
first place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That was her last race and yet I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That was her last race and yet I...
choice_data_list: Still, she looked happy.
Still, she looked like she was hav...
Get it together, Class Rep!
Pull yourself together, Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That... I can't deny.
choice_data_list: Still, she looked happy.
Still, she looked like she was hav...
Get it together, Class Rep!
Pull yourself together, Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She had such a bright and cheerful
expression on
her face both when
running and when crossing the
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I was the one focusing on her
coming in
first place.
choice_data_list: To her, that was an outcome to be ...
To her, that was an outcome to be ...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I misunderstood her wishes. I'm a
pathetic
excuse for a class
representative.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Congratulate her on her success! By all
means, I
should take the initiative!
choice_data_list: Do you understand what you need to...
Do you know what you need to do next?

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, here you are, Baku!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That was the best I've ever placed!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you and your trainer...
That was
the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: B-Baku?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A hug for giving it your all! You gave it
your best
Bakushin out there!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Yes... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O and her classmate
shed tears
of joy as they embrace each
other for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, she said she wanted to go out
with a
bang and be satisfied with her
final performance.
choice_data_list: Think back to what it was she wanted.
Remember what it was she wanted.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No way! I would stake my name as class

representative and refute such claims
with all my
heart!
choice_data_list: Then do you think she was holding ...
Then was she holding back today?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. She achieved
praiseworthy results!
choice_data_list: Then, it shouldn't matter whether ...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I feel a little disappointed...
but I guess
feeling
like that is disrespectful to her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's go back to where she is! I'm going
to shower
her with the utmost praise!
